clue.text: Greek character with pistol held up police

indicators.note: in a down light, holding the pieces up reads them from bottom to top

parts.note: eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet
a Luger is a German semi-automatic pistol

explanation.surface: A Greek gunman points a pistol skywards in a stand-off with the police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held up' turns the whole run ETA plus LUGER, reading upwards in this down light. 'police' is a verb here, as in policing rules.
explanation.definitionFit: To police an activity is to control and supervise it, the verb's synonym.

clue.text: Players attempt to make a catch

definitions.meaning: the actors in a play together form its company
an angler throws a line out to try to hook a fish

explanation.surface: Sports players try to catch a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Actors in a production are its company; flinging a fishing line is the angler's throw.

clue.text: Organic compounds forming chains, perhaps, apart from first time

indicators.note: everything except the opening letter is kept, that letter being the one named next

parts.note: chains are one example of restraints that tie an animal down

explanation.surface: Organic compounds form chains, setting aside the very first occasion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chains, perhaps' gives TETHERS by example; 'apart from first time' drops its opening T.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethers are a class of organic chemical compounds with an oxygen atom linking two carbon groups.

clue.text: Final book, having been abridged, is edited and altered

indicators.note: abridging shortens the book's title to its familiar short form

parts.note: Revelation is the last book of the Bible

explanation.surface: The last volume of a series is cut, edited and changed.
explanation.walkthrough: Revelation shortened is REV, its common abbreviation. The answer is also half of the theme phrase with 19-down.
explanation.definitionFit: Something revised has been amended and changed from its earlier form.

clue.text: Excellent husband cutting flower

indicators.note: the letter slices into the flower's name, sitting inside it

parts.note: the campion is a wild flower of the pink family
H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogies

explanation.surface: A husband snips a flower, an outstanding gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, the word means first-rate or splendid, an informal British usage.

clue.text: Doctor mentioned a change for the better

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor brought up an improvement.
explanation.definitionFit: An emendation is a correction or improvement, especially of a text.

clue.text: Multinational organisation we will cut is in poor shape

parts.note: UN is the United Nations
the two words shortened become the contraction we'll, written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: A multinational body warns that the cuts it is making leave it ailing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sick or out of sorts is being in poor shape physically.

clue.text: Banter about a couple of things wanted on course

parts.note: re means concerning, as in a letter heading

parts.words: a couple of things wanted on course
parts.note: on a golf course you need par, the standard score for a hole

parts.words: a couple of things wanted on course
parts.note: and a tee, the peg or area each hole is started from

explanation.surface: Golfers chat about a few items needed out on the course.
explanation.walkthrough: The course is a golf course, supplying two pieces at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Repartee is quick, witty conversation full of retorts, which is banter.

clue.text: Create stink with article that's proverbially erroneous

parts.note: to hum is British slang for to smell bad
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone makes a fuss over a piece of writing everyone says is mistaken.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition relies on Pope's line 'To err is human'. An anagram of NAHUM, a book of the Bible, fitting the theme.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying 'to err is human' treats people as the beings who make mistakes.

clue.text: You are reportedly in hospital with temperature, injured

parts.note: H is the map and sign abbreviation for hospital

indicators.note: said aloud, the pronoun and verb sound like two letters

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like the letters U and R

explanation.surface: A patient says you are in hospital with a fever after being hurt.
explanation.walkthrough: An anagram of RUTH, part of the Bible theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurt as an adjective means injured or wounded.

clue.text: Reached conclusion about numbers of Romans being malicious

indicators.note: the outer word goes around the other letters

parts.note: ended means finished, reached its conclusion
VI, L, M and I are Roman numerals: six, fifty, a thousand and one

explanation.surface: A story of Romans finishes with spiteful intent.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with a wicked mind has spiteful, ill-wishing intent.

clue.text: Good behaviour, we hear, in areas around stations

indicators.note: the word for good behaviour is said aloud to give a similar-sounding one

parts.note: manners are polite, good behaviour

explanation.surface: Good behaviour is expected in districts around railway stations.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'manor' is British police slang for the district a police station covers. An anagram of ROMANS, a book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: In British police slang a station's patch is its district, around each police station.

clue.text: Soldiers love appreciation, when blunder's covered up

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: the word for appreciation wraps round the mistake, hiding it

parts.note: thanks express appreciation
to err is to blunder, with 's as 'is'

explanation.surface: Soldiers love being thanked when their mistake is hushed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Other ranks are the soldiers who are not commissioned officers, a British army term.

clue.text: I have put back piece of furniture that's possible to avoid

indicators.note: the contraction is set backwards, turned end to end

parts.note: I have contracts to I've, written without the apostrophe
a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: Someone has returned a piece of furniture that could have been sidestepped.
explanation.definitionFit: Evitable is the rare opposite of inevitable: able to be avoided.

clue.text: Curse that's part of Bible, in 4 19, as are ten other answers

indicators.text: in 4 19, as are ten other answers
indicators.note: the answers to 4 and 19 name a new translation, so the book's name appears rearranged, like ten more grid entries

parts.note: Hebrews is an epistle in the New Testament

explanation.surface: An oath found in Scripture, in a new translation, like ten other words.
explanation.walkthrough: The theme key: 4 and 19 together name a new translation. Ten other answers, like HURT (Ruth) and SOMA (Amos), likewise rearrange Bible books.
explanation.definitionFit: This archaic verb means to wish evil on someone, as in Shakespeare's 'a plague on'.

clue.text: Firmly establishes earnings must be adjusted

indicators.note: adjusting the letters means reordering them

explanation.surface: Wages need to be revised, which sets them in stone.
explanation.definitionFit: To ingrain or engrain a habit is to fix it deeply and permanently.

clue.text: In a practical sense, team that's not careless

indicators.note: the team's letters go inside the other pieces

parts.note: nous is common sense or practical intelligence
XI is eleven in Roman numerals, a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: In practice, a team that's not sloppy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not careless' looks like 'careful', but it means full of care, that is worried.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone full of worry or care is the opposite of carefree, so not careless.

clue.text: University academic leader upset about club that's still going strong

indicators.note: the turned word goes around the club
in a down light, upset turns the word upside down, so it reads upwards

parts.note: a dean heads a college faculty
a bat is a club for cricket or baseball

explanation.surface: A university dean is overturned about a club, yet carries on.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down light 'upset' means reading upwards, bottom to top.
explanation.definitionFit: Unabated means without any lessening of force, so continuing as strongly.

clue.text: I must replace last piece of poem on account of one person

indicators.note: the clue's I takes the place of the poem's final letter

parts.note: a verse is a poem
taken as written, standing for on account of

explanation.surface: I have to change the end of a poem about a single person.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'I' at the start of the clue is the new letter. With 4-down it makes the theme phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A version is a particular person's description of events, their account.

clue.text: Temporarily halt start of play after second side's changed

indicators.note: the second L (left) becomes R (right): one side swapped for the other

parts.note: a prologue opens a play

explanation.surface: Stop the play briefly after the second team changes ends.
explanation.walkthrough: PROLOGUE's L, for left, is swapped for R, for right: the second side changed.
explanation.definitionFit: Proroguing Parliament suspends its sitting without dissolving it, a temporary halt.

clue.text: Took flight, thus, with miles to redeem

parts.note: ran means fled, took flight
so means thus, in this way

explanation.surface: Someone fled this way, with miles to cover to make amends.
explanation.walkthrough: An anagram of ROMANS, a theme book.
explanation.definitionFit: To ransom someone is to redeem them by paying for their release.

clue.text: Wrongfully nailed, producing no confession

indicators.note: wrong order of the letters is signalled by this adverb

explanation.surface: Wrongly crucified, he made no admission.
explanation.walkthrough: An anagram of DANIEL, a book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: A denial is a refusal to admit something, the opposite of a confession.

clue.text: Lie and improperly admit to one kind of school

definitions.text: admit to one kind of school

indicators.note: doing it improperly means the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Lying and wrongly letting someone into a school.
explanation.walkthrough: The school is a card school, a group playing cards; to deal someone in includes them in the game. Also an anagram of DANIEL.
explanation.definitionFit: To deal a player in is to give them cards, letting them join a group of card players.

clue.text: Section of island a man searched in part of Indian Ocean

indicators.note: only a section of the words is taken, the run concealed inside them

explanation.surface: Part of an island that a man combed lies in the Indian Ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The Andaman Sea is a body of water in the north-east Indian Ocean, west of Myanmar.

clue.text: Leave droppings of carnivore, small one

definitions.meaning: scram, an order to go away
the dung of a wild animal such as a fox

explanation.surface: A small animal leaves its droppings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small one' adds a hint: S (small) plus CAT, a small carnivore. An anagram of ACTS, a Bible book.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection means go away; the noun is a naturalist's word for animal excrement.

clue.text: Body a medic's turned over

indicators.note: in a down light, the letters are turned upside down, read from the bottom

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, with 's making MOS

explanation.surface: A doctor's patient's body is rolled onto its back.
explanation.walkthrough: An anagram of AMOS, a Bible book.
explanation.definitionFit: Soma is the biological term for the body as distinct from the mind or germ cells.

clue.text: Like part of a certain tree — a king hid in one, desperately

definitions.text: Like part of a certain tree

indicators.note: the letters go inside the rearranged word
acting desperately the word is thrown into disorder

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A king hid desperately in a particular tree.
explanation.walkthrough: Charles II hid in an oak at Boscobel in 1651 while fleeing; A K goes inside NOE, the jumbled ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Oaken means made of oak, the wood of a particular tree.

clue.text: Facility for addicts initially is unveiled by doctor in public

indicators.note: these letters sit inside the word for public

parts.note: open means public, not secret

indicators.note: the opening letters of the next two words are taken

parts.note: MD is a Doctor of Medicine

explanation.surface: A rehab facility is first unveiled in public by a doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Opium dens were places where users went to smoke the drug.
